recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future source changes should require a new OO decision or profile-specific requirement if additional provider/internal dietary guidance is desired.
issue_request: FHIR-7178 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient.amount. It asked to distinguish fields that are part of a provider order from fields used by internal dietary systems; the final decision said profiles constrain specific use cases and narrative/examples should explain pre-coordination of diet items into picklists.
initial_application: Git commit 5609ec13c818760a33bec3271b08615732ac4b81, titled '#6103, #7178 add notes to NO', added the NutritionOrder notes section and the text that examples show core elements, implementations may be constrained by profiles, and renal diets may use pre-coordinated nutrient components. Later editorial changes retained that note while updating wording and links.
additional_context: NutritionOrder is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO. Current scope/usage text says NutritionOrder supports physicians, dietitians/nutritionists, and speech therapists, including simple provider orders such as a physician 2 g sodium diet and more detailed information augmented by specialists. FHIR-7172 supports the same provider-versus-dietary scope question, FHIR-6103 shares the historical notes commit, and no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source still conveys the published decision without adding element-level provider/internal labels that would go beyond the resolution's profile-specific approach.
